findings.detail: Fresh lifecycle.verify_candidate(bundle, 'candidates/initial') passed. Candidate evidence equals admitted input; all registered packet and unit-source hashes, all four operation-record hashes and locators, analytic input bindings, and frozen auxiliary artifacts agree. Freeze/decision bytes were unchanged.

Static implementation matches independent integer-uniform ages 35-74, Bernoulli(0.5) sex, and three positive lognormal biomarkers formed from a triangular Gaussian factor law. The task supplies no exact demographic quotas; 3000 rows and task bounds are honored by construction. Full floating-point guards reject nonpositive/nonfinite outcomes without clipping or retries.

The latent correlation matrix has determinant (1-0.2^2)(1-r^2)>0, where r=2*sin(pi*0.529/6). Exponentials of linear normal forms have finite moments for every finite power vector. Independent recomputation verifies actual first, second and fourth moments and positive-definite biomarker covariance. Nondegenerate independent demographics yield unique population OLS projections; the age coefficient is explicitly zero by assumption.

For the actual continuous lognormal copula, marginal CDF transforms are normal CDFs. Introducing independent standard normals yields a difference-pair correlation r/2 and quadrant probability 1/4+asin(r/2)/(2*pi), proving Spearman=(6/pi)*asin(r/2). The generator uses the exact inverse, reproducing 0.529 algebraically. This is imposed model-constraint uptake, not independent validation or reconstruction of source imputation/ties.

Independent exponential-tilting/CDF arithmetic reproduces Jansen post-FPG<7 moments, separate age/gender-adjusted native-IFCC BMI slope 0.07898479964086959 and FPG slope 3.2779684166059226. Independent Bao median/log-IQR lognormal calculation gives Pearson 0.5456200148959719 and reproduces retained quantile discrepancies. The three results are analytic checks, not installed source or target coefficients.

All four admitted relationships have exactly one uptake record, correct source/evidence mapping, reachable parameter and analytic-artifact pointers, explicit selection/measurement assumptions, uncertainty and overlap descriptions. Raw disagreements against 0.13, 2.29 and 0.619 are retained. All 102 independent checks passed; no favorable-fit or CI-membership criterion was used.

All 35 quantitative feedback checks declare not_computable with null operators, and semantic bindings are unavailable with correct evidence/recipe hashes. The remaining NGSP item is contextual measurement guidance. Distinct FPG/FSG and IFCC/percent meanings are preserved; no source replay is claimed.

MIND-to-target marginal/copula transport, fixed BMI-glucose loading, age/sex independence, and unbounded lognormal tails are assumptions. The Jansen parent-equals-printed-selected approximation and unmodeled eligibility effects remain limitations; Bao rounded quantiles are not all matched. Unknown source weights, processing, ties and estimator uncertainty are not recovered or converted into precision weights. Retained source mismatches do not block implementation readiness.

No generator/author script import or execution, rows, numerical quadrature, optimization, clinical target reference, sibling construction or old experiment was used. Runtime/table validity and rare finite-sample rank failure remain for isolated final execution. Review did not close science, consume trials or deliver seeds.
